name: Armaments of War
label: Quest
description: Armaments of War: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Completion
paras: War comes, friend, and with it comes untold horrors. You have done all that could be asked of you and for that you should be rewarded.
Should this... This prophecy ever come to pass...
The future of us all could be at an end.
These armaments will prove invaluable to your campaign in this desert.
